checks.name: json_parse
checks.requirement: Every JSON file parses as UTF-8 JSON.

checks.name: utf8_text
checks.requirement: Every managed text file decodes as strict UTF-8.

checks.name: schema_contracts
checks.requirement: Selected release artifacts validate against the documented schema subset.

checks.name: context_required_fields
checks.requirement: Required sections, provenance, warnings and missing_sections are present.

checks.name: path_guards
checks.requirement: Traversal/outside-output and overwrite attempts are rejected; dry-run performs no writes.

checks.name: vnstock_read_only
checks.requirement: No write-mode SQLite connection, crawler execution or VNSTOCK file write path is implemented.

checks.name: batch_limit
checks.requirement: A batch above 10 tickers is rejected.

checks.name: provenance_fingerprint
checks.requirement: Provenance exists and fingerprint limitations are explicit.

checks.name: investment_guardrail
checks.requirement: Operating prompts prohibit guaranteed buy/sell recommendations and fabricated data.

checks.name: known_limitations
checks.requirement: Release-facing documentation states known limitations and AI usage guidance.

limitations: Static checks cannot prove absence of every runtime side effect.
The JSON Schema validator implements a documented subset, not full Draft 2020-12.

provenance.transformation: Consolidated into final v1.0 QA gate
